# ApiFn

> Generate, test, mock, diff, and document APIs from one OpenAPI contract.

## Documentation

- [Collections and tests](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/collections-and-tests.md) — Run portable request suites with assertions and reports.
- [Diff and CI](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/diff-and-ci.md) — Gate breaking contract changes and collection failures.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Create an OpenAPI contract and exercise it locally.
- [ApiFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Generate, test, mock, diff, and document APIs from one contract.
- [Interactive reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/interactive-reference.md) — Embed an explorer in React, Svelte, or DocsFn.
- [Mocking an API](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/mocking.md) — Serve an OpenAPI contract before a backend is ready.
- [OpenAPI from a router](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/openapi-from-router.md) — Use @apifn/core to derive and inspect a contract.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/python.md) — Use the separately versioned Python helpers.
- [CLI package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/cli.md) — Source guide for cli.
- [Collections package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/collections.md) — Source guide for collections.
- [Core package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/core.md) — Source guide for core.
- [DocsFn plugin](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/docsfn.md) — Source guide for docsfn.
- [Package reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — Source package guides and public API details.
- [Mock package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/mock.md) — Source guide for mock.
- [ApiFn source overview](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/overview.md) — Source guide for overview.
- [React package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/react.md) — Source guide for react.
- [Snippets package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/snippets.md) — Source guide for snippets.
- [Svelte package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/reference/svelte.md) — Source guide for svelte.
- [Request snippets](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/apifn/docs/content/docs/snippets.md) — Generate client request examples from operations.
